title: Ma ka hale me ka ʻohana
description: Ten short, simple stories about home, family and everyday life in Hawaiʻi.

lessons.title: Ka hale hou
lessons.summary: Keola and Leilani move from an old house in Honolulu to a big new house in Kailua.
lessons.text:
He hale hou ko Keola a me Leilani. Aia ka hale hou ma Kailua. He hale nui ia.

Ma mua, ua noho ʻo Keola a me Leilani ma Honolulu. Ua noho lāua ma kekahi hale kahiko. He hale kahiko ia, a ʻaʻole he hale nui.

Ua hele ʻo Keola a me Leilani i Kailua. Ua hele pū lāua me ko lāua ʻīlio. ʻĀnō, noho lāua ma ka hale hou. Nui ka hale hou. Hou nā mea a pau.

Noho ʻo Keola a me Leilani ma Kailua. Aia ko lāua hale hou ma kahi kokoke i ke kai.

Nā nīnau:
Aia ka hale hou ma hea?
Aia ka hale hou ma Kailua.
Ma hea i noho ai ʻo Keola a me Leilani ma mua?
Ua noho lāua ma Honolulu, ma kekahi hale kahiko.
He hale nui ka hale hou?
ʻAe, he hale nui ka hale hou.

lessons.title: Ka inoa o ke keiki
lessons.summary: Malia and Kawika have a baby and name him after a famous man of old.
lessons.text:
He wahine ʻo Malia. Noho ʻo ia ma Waimea me Kawika. I kekahi lā, ua hānau ʻia kekahi keiki na lāua.

"He aha ka inoa o ke keiki?" wahi a Kawika.

Ua manaʻo ʻo Malia. Ua manaʻo ʻo Kawika. Ua manaʻo lāua no ka inoa i kekahi mau lā.

"ʻO Kekoa," wahi a Malia. "ʻO Kekoa ka inoa o kekahi kanaka kaulana o ka wā kahiko."

Ua like ko lāua manaʻo. Ua kapa ʻia ke keiki ʻo Kekoa. Ua kapa ʻia ʻo ia ma ka inoa o ke kanaka kaulana. Ua hānau ʻia ʻo Kekoa i ka lā mua o ka makahiki. Noho ka wahine a me ke keiki hou ma ka hale ma Waimea.

Nā nīnau:
He aha ka inoa o ke keiki?
ʻO Kekoa ka inoa o ke keiki.
Noho ʻo Malia ma hea?
Noho ʻo Malia ma Waimea me Kawika.
Ua hānau ʻia ʻo Kekoa i ka lā hea?
Ua hānau ʻia ʻo ia i ka lā mua o ka makahiki.

lessons.title: Ka moʻolelo a Kainoa
lessons.summary: At school Kainoa writes a story about his new house, and his teacher reads it.
lessons.text:
Hele ʻo Kainoa i ke kula ma Kailua. ʻO Noelani kona kumu. He kumu kaulana ʻo ia ma ke kula.

I kekahi lā, ʻōlelo ke kumu e kākau ka papa i kekahi moʻolelo no ko lākou hale.

Kākau ʻo Kainoa i kāna moʻolelo no kona hale hou. Kākau ʻo ia ma ka ʻōlelo Hawaiʻi, ma kāna puke. He hale nui kona hale. Aia kona hale ma Kailua, ma hope o ke kula.

Ma hope, ʻike ke kumu i ka moʻolelo a Kainoa. "He moʻolelo maikaʻi kēia," wahi a ke kumu. Hoʻi ʻo Kainoa i ka hale me kāna puke e hōʻike i kāna moʻolelo i kona makuahine.

Nā nīnau:
ʻO wai ke kumu o Kainoa?
ʻO Noelani kona kumu.
Ua kākau ʻo Kainoa no ke aha?
Ua kākau ʻo ia no kona hale hou.
Aia kona hale ma hea?
Aia kona hale ma Kailua, ma hope o ke kula.

lessons.title: Nā mele a ka ʻohana
lessons.summary: People come to Haunani's house to sing old songs together and play a game.
lessons.text:
He mea nui ka mele iā Haunani. I kekahi mau lā, hele mai nā kānaka i ka hale o Haunani. He nui loa nā kānaka. Mele pū lākou a pau.

Hoʻomaka ʻo Haunani i ka mele mua. He mau mele kahiko kēia. Mele lākou e like me ka wā kahiko. ʻIke nā kānaka kahiko i nā mele a pau, akā ʻaʻole i ʻike nā keiki i kekahi mau mele. Hiki i nā keiki ke aʻo i nā mele mai nā kānaka kahiko mai. Hiki iā Haunani ke mele i nā mele a pau.

Ma hope o ka mele, hoʻomaka lākou e pāʻani i kekahi pāʻani. Like ka manaʻo o lākou a pau: he mea maikaʻi loa ka mele pū ʻana.

Nā nīnau:
Hele mai lākou i ka hale o wai?
Hele mai lākou i ka hale o Haunani.
ʻIke nā keiki i nā mele a pau?
ʻAʻole, ʻaʻole i ʻike nā keiki i kekahi mau mele.
He aha kā lākou hana ma hope o ka mele?
Pāʻani lākou i kekahi pāʻani.

lessons.title: Ka ʻāina o ke kupuna
lessons.summary: Kalani's grandfather Kapono teaches him how to look after the family's land.
lessons.text:
He ʻāina ko Kapono ma Waimea. He kahi nui ia. I ka wā kahiko, ua mālama ka ʻohana o Kapono i kēia ʻāina. ʻO Kapono ke kupuna o Kalani.

I kekahi manawa, hele ʻo Kalani i ka ʻāina me Kapono. Aʻo ʻo Kapono iā Kalani i ka mālama ʻana i ka ʻāina. "E mālama i ka ʻāina, a e mālama ka ʻāina iā ʻoe," wahi a Kapono.

Ma mua, kōkua ʻo Kalani iā Kapono i ka hana. He nui ka hana, akā kōkua ʻo ia. Ma hope o ka hana, noho lāua ma kahi o ka hale kahiko. Hōʻike ʻo Kapono i kekahi mau kiʻi kahiko o ka ʻāina. Ma kēia mau kiʻi, ʻike ʻo Kalani i ka ʻāina i ka wā mua.

He manawa nui kēia no Kalani.

Nā nīnau:
ʻO wai ke kumu e aʻo ana iā Kalani?
ʻO Kapono, kona kupuna.
Aia ka ʻāina ma hea?
Aia ka ʻāina ma Waimea.
He aha kā Kapono i hōʻike ai ma hope o ka hana?
Ua hōʻike ʻo ia i kekahi mau kiʻi kahiko o ka ʻāina.

lessons.title: I ke kūlanakauhale
lessons.summary: Leilani and her mother go to Honolulu to shop and hear a concert.
lessons.text:
Noho ʻo Leilani ma Lāʻie. I kēia lā, hele ʻo ia i ke kūlanakauhale me kona makuahine. Hele lāua i Honolulu.

He kūlanakauhale nui ʻo Honolulu. I loko o kekahi hale kūʻai nui, kūʻai ʻo Leilani i kekahi puke hou. Kūʻai kona makuahine i kekahi mau mea hou. Ma hope o ke kūʻai ʻana, hele aku lāua i kekahi hōʻike mele.

Ua hele mai nā kānaka he nui i ka hōʻike, akā ua loaʻa iā lāua kahi e noho ai. I loko o ka hale, ke mele nei kekahi poʻe kaulana. Ke mele pū nei nā kānaka a pau me lākou. "He hōʻike nui kēia!" wahi a Leilani.

I ka hope, hoʻi mai lāua i Lāʻie. He kūlanakauhale maikaʻi ʻo Honolulu, akā ʻo Lāʻie ko Leilani wahi.

Nā nīnau:
Hele ʻo Leilani i hea i kēia lā?
Hele ʻo ia i Honolulu, i ke kūlanakauhale.
He aha kā Leilani i kūʻai ai?
Ua kūʻai ʻo ia i kekahi puke hou.
Ma hope o ke kūʻai ʻana, hele aku lāua i hea?
Hele aku lāua i kekahi hōʻike mele.

lessons.title: Ka lā hānau o Keoni
lessons.summary: Keoni turns ten; his family meets at his house and he gets a new songbook.
lessons.text:
I kēia lā, he lā hānau ko Keoni. He ʻumi ona makahiki. E hui ana kona poʻe a pau ma ko Keoni hale. ʻO kēia ka lā i hānau ai ʻo ia.

Hele mai nā kānaka a pau. Ua hōʻike kona makuahine iā ia i kekahi mea nui. Hiki ʻole iā Keoni ke ʻike i ka mea i loko. Hiki ʻole iā ia ke kali.

He aha ia? He puke! He ʻano puke hou ia, he puke mele. Ua loaʻa iā Keoni ka puke mua o kona makahiki hou.

Hōʻike ʻo Keoni i kāna puke i nā kānaka a pau. Ma ka hale kahi i hui ai lākou, e mele ana lākou i nā mele o ka puke. Ua loaʻa iā lākou he lā maikaʻi.

Nā nīnau:
He lā aha kēia lā no Keoni?
He lā hānau ko Keoni.
He aha ke ʻano o ka puke?
He ʻano puke mele ia.
He aha ka mea i loaʻa iā Keoni?
Ua loaʻa iā ia he puke mele hou.

lessons.title: Ka huakaʻi i Molokaʻi
lessons.summary: Kekoa and his friend Kaleo fly to Molokaʻi and stay with Kaleo's aunt.
lessons.text:
Noho ʻo Kekoa ma ka mokupuni ʻo Oʻahu. I kēia manawa, hele ʻo ia me Kaleo i ka mokupuni ʻo Molokaʻi. He mokupuni ʻē ʻo Molokaʻi iā Kekoa.

Ma ka mokulele, ʻike lāua mai luna mai i nā mokupuni ʻē aʻe.

Ma Molokaʻi, noho lāua ma ka hale o kekahi wahine. Pili ka wahine iā Kaleo ma ka ʻohana. Pili ka hale i ke kai. Aia ka hale ma waena o ke kai a me ke kūlanakauhale.

I kekahi lā, hele lāua i luna aʻe o kekahi mauna. Mai luna aku, ʻike lāua i ka mokupuni a pau. "ʻAʻole nui nā kūlanakauhale ma Molokaʻi. He ʻāina ʻē kēia," wahi a Kekoa. Ma waena o nā mokupuni a pau, makemake nui ʻo ia iā Molokaʻi.

Nā nīnau:
Ua hele ʻo Kekoa i hea?
Ua hele ʻo ia i ka mokupuni ʻo Molokaʻi.
Ua noho lāua ma ka hale o wai?
Ua noho lāua ma ka hale o kekahi wahine pili iā Kaleo.
Aia ka hale ma hea?
Aia ka hale ma waena o ke kai a me ke kūlanakauhale.

lessons.title: Ka ʻoihana hou o Kealoha
lessons.summary: Teacher Kealoha is chosen to lead his school, and his wife Puanani helps him.
lessons.text:
He kumu ʻo Kealoha ma kekahi kula ma Wailuku. Aʻo ʻo ia i ka papa ʻelima.

I kekahi lā, ua koho ʻia ʻo Kealoha e nā kumu o ke kula. E lilo ana ʻo ia i alakaʻi no ke kula. Hoʻi ʻo ia i ka hale a ʻōlelo i kāna wahine, ʻo Puanani: "Ua koho ʻia wau! E lilo ana wau i alakaʻi."

Ma ka ʻoihana hou, ʻaʻole ʻo Kealoha e aʻo ana i kekahi papa. Hoʻohana ʻo ia i kona manawa a pau no nā kumu a me nā keiki. Hoʻohana ʻo ia i kāna puke e kākau i nā mea a pau.

Ma hope, hoʻi mai ʻo ia i ka hale. Na Puanani i hana i ka ʻai. "He nui ka hana," wahi a Kealoha, "akā he hana maikaʻi kēia."

Nā nīnau:
He aha ka ʻoihana mua o Kealoha?
He kumu ʻo ia ma kekahi kula ma Wailuku.
Na wai ʻo Kealoha i koho?
Na nā kumu o ke kula ʻo ia i koho.
He aha kāna ʻoihana hou?
Ua lilo ʻo ia i alakaʻi no ke kula.

lessons.title: Ke kula ʻōlelo Hawaiʻi
lessons.summary: Kahiau writes about how the Hawaiian-language schools were founded and became famous.
lessons.text:
Hele ʻo Kahiau i kekahi kula ʻōlelo Hawaiʻi ma Kāneʻohe. Ma kēia kula, ʻōlelo nā kumu a me nā keiki ma ka ʻōlelo Hawaiʻi.

I kekahi lā, ua kākau ʻo Kahiau i kekahi moʻolelo no kona kula. I ka wā kahiko, ua ʻōlelo nā kānaka a pau ma ka ʻōlelo Hawaiʻi. Ma hope, ua lilo ke aupuni i ka poʻe ʻē, a ua hoʻohana ke aupuni i ka ʻōlelo Pelekānia ma nā kula.

I ka makahiki 1987, ua hoʻokumu kekahi poʻe i nā kula ʻōlelo Hawaiʻi mua. ʻAʻole i kōkua ke aupuni ma mua, akā ua hoʻokumu lākou i nā kula.

ʻĀnō, ua kaulana kēia mau kula ma ka honua. Hele mai ka poʻe o ka honua e ʻike. Ua kaulana kona kula.

Nā nīnau:
Hele ʻo Kahiau i ke kula hea?
Hele ʻo ia i kekahi kula ʻōlelo Hawaiʻi ma Kāneʻohe.
Na wai i hoʻokumu i nā kula ʻōlelo Hawaiʻi mua?
Na kekahi poʻe i hoʻokumu i nā kula mua.
I ka wā kahiko, ua ʻōlelo nā kānaka ma ka ʻōlelo hea?
Ua ʻōlelo lākou ma ka ʻōlelo Hawaiʻi.
